description: Estimate what a family trip costs, broken down by getting there, staying, eating, getting around, parks and activities, and extras, with a low to high range, the source and date behind every figure, and a confidence score. Works for city trips, all-inclusive resorts, cruises and theme parks. Figures come from Endless Travel Plans' verified price data and the observed fares and room rates of real family budgets, never live prices; follow calculator_url for live prices. Places ETP has no data for come back as unsupported rather than a guess.

children_ages.description: Age of each child, one entry per child (ages decide seats, tickets and meal prices). Empty for no children.

departure_city.description: Home city or airport the family leaves from, for getting there. Without it, flights use a typical distance and say so.

destination.description: Where the family is going: a city ("Chicago"), a theme park ("Walt Disney World"), a beach area for an all-inclusive ("Cancun"), or a cruise ("Royal Caribbean Caribbean cruise").

month.description: Month of travel, as a name ("July") or number ("7"). Defaults to about two months out.

trip_type.description: city, all_inclusive, cruise or theme_park. Inferred from the destination when left out.

name: estimate_family_trip_budget
title: Estimate a family trip budget
